about_the_game:
OVERALL THIS DEMO FEATURES:

  • A playtime of between 25-30 minutes

  • A custom tutorial level for this demo to teach you the basics

  • A slice of a mid-game level to introduce some of the puzzle mechanics that will be seen in the full release

Exo-archaeologist Bale arrives on Tor Ulsat with his colleague Jen, an exo-linguist, to study the ruins of the lost Tor civilisation. But when he unwittingly activates the Chronolith - an ancient alien device - reality shatters. Jen vanishes, and Bale is trapped in a fractured world where time loops and echoes of the past and future bleed together.

With no way to contact mission control, Bale must navigate countless obstacles, unravel the fate of the Tor, and outwit the cryptic and mysterious forces that oppose him. As reality unravels and truth remains buried in the ruins, Bale's only hope is to solve the mystery of the Tor - before he's lost to the loop forever.

Record, re-record, and replay. Use the unique 'Echo Branching' mechanic to record your actions and engage with up to three echoes of your past self. Harness these duplicates to skillfully learn to manipulate ancient alien systems that once seemed impossible to navigate.

name: Causal Loop Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 TI or AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio or onboard sound card
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements are for playing Causal Loop at 1080p resolution with medium settings, aiming for a stable 60 FPS. For lower resolutions or less demanding graphical settings, the game may run smoothly on systems with slightly lower specs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700F or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 or AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio or onboard sound card
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements are designed to deliver an optimal 4K gaming experience with high settings, ensuring smooth performance at 60 FPS or higher. This configuration is ideal for players seeking the best visual quality and performance in Causal Loop at higher resolutions.

short_description: Causal Loop is a narrative puzzler in which you solve intricate puzzles on a remote alien world by using the unique “echo” mechanic. Record, replay, and interact with past versions of yourself in this demo for Causal Loop!
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
